// diagnostic

E2115

No debug info for build `{build}` is in `.jet/symbols` here or in a directory above.

What

No debug info for build `{build}` is in `.jet/symbols` here or in a directory above.

Why

A release build saves its function names and lines under `.jet/symbols/.build-id/` in the project that built it; any other build, even of the same source, has another id.

Fix

Run `jet crash` in the project that built the crashed program, and keep its `.jet/symbols` with each release you ship.
